name: Premium Large Breeds Puppies Dry Dog Food
label: Chicken 14 kg

breed-size.quote: For puppies of large breeds (with a weight from 25 to 90 kg)

health-feature.quote: Chondroitin and glucosamine for bones and joints health

texts.about_this_item: Club 4 Paws Premium complete dry food for puppies of large breeds (adult weight 25 to 90 kg) up to 1 year of age, with chicken. 28/15 well-balanced growth and development formula for everyday feeding, made with 100% quality animal protein. Chondroitin and glucosamine for bone and joint health; Omega 3 + Omega 6 for healthy skin and a shiny coat; vitamins D3, E, B1, B5, microelements and amino acids; a mixture of tocopherols as a natural antioxidant. INTEGRAMIX formula of dried tomatoes, ginger, hawthorn and bananas for general health and strong immunity. No artificial flavours or colours.
texts.ingredient_information: Composition: chicken meal 29 %, maize, rice, wheat, poultry fat (preserved with tocopherols), maize gluten, hydrolyzed animal protein, sugar beet pulp, minerals, salmon oil 0,5 %, brewery yeast, linseed 0,4 %, banana* 0,23 %, tomatoes* 0,2 %, hawthorn* 0,065 %, ginger* 0,01 %. Analytical constituents: crude protein 28 %, сrude fat 15 %, crude ash 6,2 %, crude fibre 2,3 %, calcium 1,3 %, phosphorus 1 %, omega-3 fatty acids 0,37 %, omega-6 fatty acids 3,36 %. Metabolizable energy per 100 g: 1 607,79 kJ (384,27 kcal).
texts.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding guide by puppy age and expected adult weight is printed on the pack. Always provide fresh drinking water.
